0022600126.text: The Utah Jazz (1-1, 5th in the Northwest and 9th in the West) host the Memphis Grizzlies (2-0, 2nd in the Southwest and 5th in the West), with Utah 1-0 at home and Memphis on a two-game winning streak. Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise) are both out for the Jazz, and Zach Edey (ankle) is out for Memphis. The teams split 2-2 in 2025-26, and in 2026-27 the Jazz trail 0-1, after losing 123-103 in Memphis on October 21.
